0.why: Sawtooth-VCO.cpp: setChannels then setVoltage(volume_out * wave, idx), the wave table being filled to ±5V, commit 55aa542, the 2.4.1 release commit, whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.4.1 and whose res/ matches the installed panels

comment: Four tables are held: band-unlimited and band-limited, each in an up and a down ramp. The band-limited ramp is the sum of sin(j * x) / j for j from 1 to the harmonic count, then scaled so its peak is 5V. Changing the Harmonics menu rebuilds the tables inside process(). The pitch knob is linear in Hz. volume_out is never clamped.
